hero.headline: Building the systems
hero.lead: I'm Kachalla Ahmad Galadima, a Computer Engineering student at Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria, focused on control and automation, embedded systems, and artificial intelligence. I design IoT-based and PLC-driven solutions that make everyday systems safer, smarter, and more efficient.

about.title: What I am working towards
paragraphs: Hello! My name is Kachalla Ahmad Galadima. I am a Computer Engineering student with a passion for automation and control systems, software development, embedded systems, and artificial intelligence. I enjoy learning new technologies and solving real-world control and automation problems. My goal is to become a professional control engineer capable of building innovative solutions that improve lives.
This site is a simple record of what I am learning, building, and working towards. Have a look around to see my education, skills, projects, hobbies, and ways to contact me.
